notes: Assumptions: boerewors 281 kcal / 100 g (see the reference; the brand range moves this roll by -100 to +190 kcal); counted raw, with no allowance for fat dripping off on the braai; hot dog rolls ~55 g; butter and the optional mustard counted. Each roll has 167 g raw wors (~470 kcal), a 55 g roll (~155 kcal) and ~115 kcal of butter, oil and relish. No reliable per-roll figure was found (a bigoven entry of 62 kcal is clearly broken). Component check: Arise boerewors 414 kcal for 150 g, and its boerewors roll with wedges at 990 kcal for 410 g; take away ~350 kcal of wedges and that roll lands at ~640 kcal.
